title: Not what I thought it was.
text: Not what I thought it was.. Definitely something that you need to get used to. You also need quite a bit of upper body strength! The idea behind this chopper was cool but it does need a little more work. It's time consuming because it won't cut through unless it's already a small slice of veggie which makes it kinda pointless to me because I might as well just go that extra mile because then the cleaning of it is annoying and tedious. Good idea bad design.
